text: Chapter 11: Off to Toram@Intense Battle in Coenubia's Stronghold
■Next Mission\nStart from Erva Tronc: Leader's House.
Head to Mt. Vulcani to investigate the identity of a\nsuspicious figure that may be the key to discovering who is\ncontrolling the moving forest!
You see Arstida, a fortress-like structure created by\nCoenubias, at the mid point of the mountain.\nAs it may be a threat to the Eumanos, let's clear it!
While defeating Coenubia monsters, keep going deeper until\nyou see the Coenubia boss that is waiting for you at the\ndeepest area of Arstida!
Defeat Velum, the Coenubia boss, and destroy Arstida!
